problem: GCS disconnected and reconnected repeatedly once SLAM mapping started; SLAM tab showed an old map instead of a live one. User asked for every Testing option to be exercised locally for bugs and glitches.
scope: Browser GCS (tauri_app), web host (aerothon_runtime/web.py), GCS aggregator map/pose forwarding. Display and host only; no flight decision module changed.

rig.description: Fake FCU/lidar/growing SLAM map/execution service on ROS 2 Jazzy (WSL, FASTDDS SHM), the real gcs_aggregator (managed) and the real web host with a sleeping stand-in runtime; browser pane at http://localhost:8897/.
rig.start: wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- env ARENA_W=40 ARENA_H=30 bash .scratch/gcs_testing_20261018/run_stack.sh, then POST /api/connect {profile_id: benchsim}

findings.bug: SLAM canvas rebuilt the full occupancy grid on every telemetry frame (measured 52 rebuilds in 5 s, ~31% main thread on a laptop for 880x680 cells); a slower device falls behind, misses the host ping window and is disconnected (reproduced: 8 s main-thread stall -> code 1006 and reconnect)
findings.fix: rasterise once per map with a typed-array pass, draw per animation frame; browser heartbeat 5 s -> 10 s (pong window 5 s)
findings.evidence: after: 10 rasterisations in 10 s (one per map), no long animation frames in 6 s

findings.bug: page kept its last map across reconnects and runtime/profile changes; a reconnecting page had no map until the next publication
findings.fix: aggregator and web host replay the newest map to a new connection; page clears the map when profile_id/runtime changes or slam_toolbox restarts

findings.bug: aggregator 1.0 s throttle against slam_toolbox map_update_interval 1.0 dropped about every other map (7 maps in 15 s observed)
SLAM map had no aircraft position; map did not refit as it grew; Live/Stale label flickered at a 3 s threshold; status/legend text clipped by a fixed-height container
findings.fix: slam_toolbox /pose -> telemetry slam_pose; aircraft, track and live scan drawn in the map frame; auto-follow until the operator pans; map age chip (live <5 s, slow <15 s, stale); layout fixed

findings.bug: web host refused lidar_cal_geometry and lidar_cal_background as unknown commands; calibration wizard could not pass step 1
findings.fix: added to the web host command list

findings.bug: a refused Start showed its reason for ~0.2 s, then the execution node's republished previous run replaced it; receipts never reached the event log
findings.fix: only results for this page's latest command replace the outcome line; receipts and execution transitions are logged

findings.bug: malformed waypoint text threw an uncaught exception with no message
errors and outcomes were drawn behind open Arena/Lidar dialogs
a disabled Review start gave no reason
index.html served without Cache-Control; browsers kept the previous GCS after a deploy (observed in the rig)
findings.fix: no-cache for pages, immutable for hashed assets; pages opened before this fix need one manual reload
